title: Warehouse Productivity Improvement
summary: Warehouse Productivity Improvement is a focused Distribution operating project that connects a specific business problem to workstreams, data, KPIs, and expected value impact.
businessProblem: Distribution companies often lose margin, growth, or cash when warehouse productivity improvement is not managed with a clear owner and KPI baseline.
goal: Create a measurable improvement plan that management can execute through weekly operating cadence.
expectedImpact: Expected impact should be underwritten as run-rate EBITDA, cash release, risk reduction, or exit-story improvement after baseline validation.
